headline: Slave drivers measure how hard you work, not how well you perform.
caption:

headline: Know how crowded the mall is before you go.
caption:
Paydays on the 15th and 30th fill malls fast. CrowdSense adds patterns like those, plus mall sales and expos, to foot-traffic forecasts. The numbers are estimates, and the app says so clearly. It works on your phone at crowdsense.net.

headline: Speed is part of the design, not an extra.
caption:
People compare your site with the fastest ones they use every day, not only with your competitors. This short web.dev piece shows how load time affects whether visitors stay, and it’s a good starting point if you run a small business site.

topic: one dashboard on a Raspberry Pi and as a screensaver
headline: One dashboard, three places to run it.
caption:
Threat Monitor shows what a screensaver can do: live data, not just a logo. The same dashboard runs on a Raspberry Pi or as a screensaver on Windows and macOS. It’s open source under the MIT license, so anyone can read the code at github.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor.

topic: clarity: good design shouldn't need explaining
headline: If it needs explaining, it isn’t finished yet.
caption:
A website, an app or a screensaver should make sense the moment someone sees it. When people need a guide to use it, the design still has work to do. So I keep cutting until the next step is obvious.
